simple: Protection for AI agents as a new kind of privileged account. Discovers agents and MCP servers across SaaS, cloud and development environments and brings them into a single registry with context: owner, purpose, status, permissions. A broker (Agent Identity Broker) grants an agent access to resources only for the duration of a specific task and takes it away right after; if an agent strays from its task or behaves oddly, its access can be cut off instantly (Kill Switch). Records agent actions — what was done, by which agent and on behalf of which user; provides access reviews and lifecycle management for an agent from creation to retirement. Also available in Prisma AIRS; check licensing with your distributor.
